Description
The Wycombe Abbey International Changzhou campus covers an area of 25 acres and has state-of-the-art facilities with three distinctive round buildings housing the sports centre and arts and drama departments. The campus has a fully equipped theatre, 400-metre outdoor running track, inflatable air dome sports stadium, indoor basketball courts, multiple floodlit tennis courts, indoor sports fields, a purpose-built water sports centre and swimming pools and as it is situated by a lake, it has world-class rowing facilities. For music, there are smaller performance, rehearsal and ensemble rooms, practice rooms, music teaching classrooms, and a jam room complete with the latest technology for all electronic instruments. Pupils have endless opportunities to participate and perform in sport, music and drama.
